candidates.name: OGC 3D Portrayal Service
verified_facts: OGC 3D Portrayal Service specifies interoperable delivery of geospatial 3D content and how that content is described, selected and delivered.
The standard focuses on portrayal delivery rather than a specific source-content transmission format.
semantic_limits: 3D portrayal or visual detail is not evidence of raw survey precision, bare-earth semantics, vertical datum or parcel elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: OGC Two Dimensional Tile Matrix Set
verified_facts: OGC Two Dimensional Tile Matrix Set defines regular grid tiling schemes and tile-set metadata over a limited set of scales in a CRS.
Tiles are indexed by tile matrix, row and column within the defined tiling scheme.
semantic_limits: Tile matrix scale, zoom level or tile dimensions do not prove the original terrain source ground-sample distance, survey density or vertical accuracy.
